title: Helion Energy
description: A cool fusion-lab palette: pale steel page (#eef2f5) with deep navy ink and a navy nav pill, near-black bands (#0f0f15) for machines and footer, one plasma magenta kept for glows. Inter set tight in caps for display, Geist Mono for uppercase labels, small 4–8px radii, no shadows. Dark sibling: the whole page on near-black with a pale steel-blue glow.
notes: light is the faithful mode; the original's near-black bands use the .dark values (blocks put the `dark` class on them)
Inter and Geist Mono are the original's own faces (both open-licence)
glow is magenta in light (plasma) and pale steel-blue in .dark (the careers spotlight)
gutter and section padding are fluid clamps (10→56px, 95→133px between 390 and 1440)
name: helionenergy-theme
